dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderately concave trailing edge following a parabolic spline from the posterior dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a medium pixel radius, lacking sharp terminal vertex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin at approximately 55 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Highly convex, hemispherical melon boundary with a tight radius.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a width-to-length ratio near 1:1.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse inflection point at approximately 130 degrees at the rostrum-melon junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple faint, parallel linear depigmentation marks oriented vertically on the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity specular highlights (lighting bloom) obscuring fine texture on the upper dorsal and cranial regions.
